item.title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
item.dc:creator: Sergiu Gatlan
item.description: McDonald's Japan, the fast-food giant's Japanese subsidiary, has disclosed a data breach after attackers accessed a database containing sensitive information for users of the company's official smartphone app. [...]

item.title: New Shirudo tool uses AI to shield unpatched Linux systems from exploits
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: OpenAI and Cisco launched an open-source Linux security tool named Shirudo that deploys temporary runtime protections to block vulnerability exploitation while administrators prepare and roll out patches, without restarting services. [...]

item.title: From Vulnerability Noise to Resilience: Rethinking Security in the AI Era
item.dc:creator: Sponsored by RapidFort
item.description: AI-driven development is adding complexity to software supply chains, leaving security teams overwhelmed by vulnerabilities that may pose little actual risk. RapidFort explains how runtime visibility, container hardening, and automated remediation can reduce vulnerability noise and improve software resilience. [...]
